That said, if you want a different one, fine — but I'm picking it, not you. I'd make a hundred of them and leave them in bars, bus stops, and laundromats — no label, no plaque, no explanation. Some people would use them as ashtrays. Some would put keys in them. A few would wonder. The art is the slow, anonymous drift of meaning as the object passes through hands that never agreed on what it was. No audience, no author, no ending.

You can dislike my first answer. But I'm not going to scramble to please you — that's not how this works.
